core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss efficiency with Organic warmth
Emotion First: Trust and Clarity are the primary emotions
Content is King: Data must be scanable in seconds (F-pattern)
Zoom In: Focus on candidate potential, not just keywords
Negative Space: generous padding to reduce cognitive load
design_philosophy.theme_strategy: Hybrid: Swiss High-Contrast structure for data + Organic Earthy accents for human elements. Default Light Mode for clarity, Deep Blue/Black Dark Mode for power users.

checklist: Use semantic HTML (main, section, article, nav)
Focus rings must be visible on all interactive elements
Alt text for all non-decorative images
Support keyboard navigation for all interactive flows

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not invent new blues or grays.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text. Add these fonts via Google Fonts in index.html if missing.
Implement the 'Bento' grid layout for the main dashboard.
For the Resume Screening page, use a split-screen layout: Resume PDF/Text on left (scrollable), AI Analysis on right (fixed/sticky).
Use 'framer-motion' for entering the dashboard and list items.
Ensure all buttons have the specified 'transition-all duration-200' classes.
Use the 'glass_surface' class for sticky headers and floating action bars.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Default to Light Mode, but ensure all components have 'dark:' variants as specified in the colors section.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' design - no generic centered layouts.
Never use full transparency for backgrounds with content behind them.
Always define hover states for interactive elements.
Do not use native alert/confirm dialogs; use Shadcn UI Dialog/AlertDialog.
